✨ Speed-Test | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a simple, lightweight, and secure way to measure network performance directly from a web browser without requiring any client-side software or plugins.
✨ Key Features: • Free and Open-Source • HTML5 Network Performance Estimation Tool • Written in Vanilla JavaScript • Uses only built-in Web APIs (XMLHttpRequest, HTML, CSS, JS, SVG) • No Third-Party frameworks or libraries required
📖 Summary: SpeedTest by OpenSpeedTest™ is a free, open-source HTML5 tool for estimating network performance. Written in vanilla JavaScript, it uses only built-in web APIs and requires no third-party frameworks, making it lightweight and secure. It can be hosted on any static web server.
